metadata.author: The Wiggles
metadata.description: Get ready to sing, dance, and giggle with The Wiggles in this brand-new collection of Wiggly Nursery Rhymes! Join Anthony, Lachy, Simon, and Tsehay as they dress up, get silly, and bring your favourite nursery rhymes to life. From the cheerful sounds of ‘Old MacDonald Had a Farm’ to the gentle sparkle of ‘Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star', this collection is packed with fun for little ears. Wiggle along to ‘Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes’, hop on for 'Wheels on the Bus', and discover even more musical adventures in Wiggle Town, where the fun never ends. Perfect for playtime, car rides, or winding down before bed—this is a must-have for every little Wiggly fan!
